messages:
maria: Heads-up — PR 4928 touches the model catalog matrix for the new zephyr-mini variants plus an edge-case note on embedding sharding. Need a quick docs sweep and a tiny SDK snippet showing quantized fallback. cc @zach @devon :eyes:
zach: Looking now. Main things to validate: limits table (seq_len / batch_size), the runtime compatibility column, and the bench link. Also check the variant labels — we had a rename last week. :mag:
devon: I can own the SDK snippet. Do we want JS + Python minimal examples?
priya: Both would be useful. Also add a short note about partial-shard fallback when sharding embeddings (small batches can hit non-sharded codepath).
devon: OK I'll draft JS + Python. Plan: show how to request 'zephyr-mini-quant' and fall back to 'zephyr-mini' if quant kernels aren't available. Pushing inline to the PR as a code block.
maria: Bench link is https://bench.internal/redwood/zephyr-mini-vs-quant — one latency column looks suspicious (quant shows higher p95). Can someone re-download the raw CSV?
zach: I'll pull the raw CSV and sanity-check. If the link is wrong maybe it's pointing at an old report path. Will report back.
devon: Snippet pushed to PR as docs/snippets/zephyr-quant-fallback.md. Example in the PR shows both languages and a short note about expected perf delta.
priya: Small nit: model card currently lists 'A100-16GB' under supported hardware for 13B variants; we only validate 13B on A100-40GB and H100. Can we change that to avoid customer confusion?
maria: Good catch — I'll update the model-card YAML and the variants table to remove the 16GB entry and add a short note about GPU memory recommendations.
docs-bot: PR 4928 status: CI passed, but docs-lint flagged a broken link to /bench (404).
zach: :thumbsup: I'll open a tiny follow-up to fix the bench URL and verify the CSV.
devon: One more doc suggestion: add a 1-paragraph migration note for customers switching from 'zephyr' -> 'zephyr-mini' about tokenizer differences (chunking can change). Example prompt + tokenizer config would help.
maria: Agreed, adding migration example + a tiny eval prompt set.
priya: When that's in, can someone run the Quickstart embed example end-to-end? I want to confirm the sharding example still behaves as documented.
devon: Ran Quickstart locally on an edge-quant node with small batches — behavior matches the new docs (partial-shard fallback triggers as described).
maria: Awesome. Targeting merge by EOD after the link fix. @zach please follow up on the bench URL.
zach: On it — updating by 3349998905.
maria: Merged after bench URL fix. :sparkles:
